title: Sore Throat
summary: Soothe a scratchy throat with warm gargles
ayurvedicView: A sore throat with mucus is linked to Kapha; burning and redness to Pitta. Warm gargles and soothing, sweet herbs calm both.
remedies: Warm salt-water gargle with a pinch of turmeric, three to four times a day
Honey in warm water or ginger tea (no honey for children under one)
Mulethi (licorice) root to chew or as tea, for a few days only
Tulsi leaves steeped in hot water
Rest your voice and sip warm fluids
prevention: Do not share cups or utensils when someone is ill
tips: Avoid very cold drinks and ice cream
seeDoctor: Trouble swallowing saliva or breathing, or drooling
Fever above 38.5°C with white patches on the tonsils
A sore throat lasting more than a week
A new rash, or very tender swollen glands in the neck
